node.title: Joint derivative ideal detects exactly the C36' double-accident primes
node.statement: For each of the 29 official dyadic orders, quotient separation unit-normalizes the cutoff-18 product derivative ideal on every R=1 fiber using exponent B_n=min(n-19,ceil(33n^(2/3))-19). The resulting odd integer f_n divides gcd(e_n,h_n^B_n), where h_n is the odd quotient-discriminant integer, and satisfies p^Y_18|f_n and p|f_n iff Y_18>0 for every official row prime. Thus primes outside f_n close C36', while the global discriminant-height envelope is quantitatively insufficient and a residual-size or target-local valuation bound remains open.
